constraints.description: Every Flint plan and OpenSpec acceptance criterion maps to direct, reproducible evidence without a silent mandatory skip.

validation.validation_method: acceptance matrix, task receipts, focused current checks, clean full CI, strict OpenSpec, and signed KBD state

constraints.description: Default CI is machine-portable, while the explicitly enabled real Flint SDK lane fails when immutable source or compatible build artifacts are unavailable.

validation.validation_method: portable tests, negative missing-root receipt, live 1/1 receipt, workflow ref/hash checks, and source scan

constraints.description: The consumed watchEntities/mutateEntity and ENTITY_CHANGE contract is verified against the checked fixture and fourteen external source files whose Git HEAD, pinned commit blobs, and working-tree SHA-256 digests match the contract.

validation.validation_method: portable verifier, exact Git HEAD equality, pinned commit blob hashes, independent working-tree hashes, real-SDK normalized-graph round trip, and pinned revisions

constraints.description: Issuer, tenant equality, kid, RSA/EC JWKS truth, role/key separation, and client service-role credential boundaries fail closed across repository-owned text-like example files and generated outputs, including dot-env and config files; dependency and cache exclusions are explicit in the receipt.

validation.validation_method: security drift regressions, BDD, 481-file repository-owned text-like client scan with 250 binaries classified separately, generated-output traversal, explicit dependency/cache exclusions, dot-env/name/value-level service-role regressions, and current Gate source hashes

constraints.description: Forge plan/apply/status/DDL, service-role-only provisioning, RLS, audit, and restart semantics are documented from pinned source without claiming an unbuilt adapter.

validation.validation_method: Forge hash receipt, verifier rejection tests, release documentation, and adapter-claim scan

constraints.description: Coverage, human API documentation, public export ledgers, and agent skills agree with the unchanged public Flint package surface.

validation.validation_method: coverage verifier, 203 React exports plus companion ledgers, documentation verifier, and task-4 receipt

constraints.description: The cumulative change has a serialized clean repository pass, current focused checks, and green Node 22/24/26 plus Tauri evidence at its declared candidate SHA.

validation.validation_method: task-5 clean receipt, current task-6 focused checks, PR run URLs, and evidence hashes

constraints.description: Remote main remains the frozen React RC source, npm next remains absent, fixed-group/publication authority is unchanged, and this Flint archive is not described as full 3.0 certification.

validation.validation_method: remote main SHA, npm dist-tags, fixed Changesets policy, coverage releaseCertified=false, and release-impact wording

global_rules: pnpm is the only JavaScript package manager.
A portable fixture cannot be relabeled as real external SDK execution.
A pinned external-source contract cannot be relabeled as a locally implemented Forge adapter.
Client/browser surfaces never receive service-role material.
The frozen React rc.1 source on remote main and npm registry state must not move in this change.
termination_conditions: All eight blocking constraints have direct current evidence.
Both manifest variants exist and are non-empty, and manifest/constraints/state are schema-valid.
No observed implementation correction remains before isolated review.
Archive proceeds only after a fresh isolated adversarial review has no critical finding.
